findings.label: type param not validated at controller boundary
findings.detail: unflagContent throws BadRequestException for invalid type values, but only at the service layer. TypeScript union types are erased at runtime, so any string from @Param('type') passes unvalidated. Add a @IsIn(['question','answer']) pipe or explicit enum check at the controller level.

findings.label: Silent loading-state persistence in _resolve after unmount
findings.detail: In _ReportsScreenState._resolve, the finally block guards setState(() => _actionLoading.remove(item.id)) with if (mounted). If the widget is disposed while a PATCH is in-flight, the loading entry is never cleared. Remove the mounted guard in finally so the key is always removed, matching the connections_screen.dart reference pattern.
